meaning: Implementation coverage within the bounded capture/inspection profile; no compatibility detector, index or plan acceptance.

cases.scope: Exact bytes, detached reconstruction and original metadata survive. Automatic reuse and plan checks are deferred.
Frozen parent bytes are copied/verified in isolated source/owned cases. Generic relocation and collection correspondence are deferred.
No supplier availability/display refresh interface is implemented.
Later public molecular translation cannot mutate captured bytes. Source-change detection and recapture policy are caller-owned and deferred.
Only explicit state0/frame0 are admitted. Cross-state topology/protonation/stereo/conformer equivalence is not tested.
Original participant/geometry order survives; out-of-axis and boolean indices refuse. In-range source authentication and molecular remapping are deferred.
Repeated source with a new occurrence key changes its binding without collapsing features. Collection multiplicity/order and asset rebind are deferred.
Full explicit requested/empty coverage is retained. No automatic superset reuse or missing-family execution is implemented.
Equivalent requested family order/duplicates canonicalize while ordered native output remains unchanged. No plan compatibility claim.
Unknown definitions refuse. Alternative perception methods and migration are deferred.
Original donor directions, aromatic normals and signed charges reconstruct and pass public correspondence. Changed-orientation reuse decisions are deferred.
nm/pm application policies preserve independently checked physical values and original sealed quantities. A generic derived-payload conversion/requalification service is deferred.
Nonzero frame/state and unsupported coordinate policy refuse. Multi-frame/PBC transformations are deferred.
No retrieval predicate identity or implementation comparator is added.
No query or retrieval asset is created.
No scoring/grouping/budget plan or resume decision is added.
Unsupported feature families refuse before metadata/extraction. Broader semantic/numerical retrieval qualification is deferred.
No bin representation or production index is selected.
Complete requested aromatic family is evaluated empty and preserved distinctly from controlled producer failure; no activity inference.
Incomplete/invalid parent/request/coverage/producer declarations refuse. Structurally valid false origin declarations are not authenticated.
Unknown schema, checksum mismatch, noncanonical/duplicate/oversized bytes and invalid layout refuse. Quantity semantics require explicit reconstruction.
No candidate-prefix execution or unknown-work accounting is added.
Driver refuses existing outputs and preserves partial/failure evidence. Atomic replacement/current-pointer publication is deferred.
All159runtime bodies remain unchanged. No historical run reader migration or broader legacy acceptance is executed.
